# The compost heap is not a single temperature

The centre is warm enough to steam while the edge is almost cold. A solitary probe would have said the heap was working beautifully. Turned the outer layer in and found the cardboard still dry. Add moisture before adding more kitchen scraps. [[Garden notebook]]: record where the probe went and what the material felt like, not just the highest reading.
